njangi.title: Everyone pays in, the pot goes round, everyone benefits.
njangi.p1: In Cameroon, a njangi (also called a tontine) brings neighbours, colleagues and friends together. Each month, everyone puts their share into the same pot, and the whole pot goes to one member, in turn. Nobody keeps the money for themselves.
njangi.p2: On the pitch, the ball is the pot. The pass is the contribution. The goal is the pot paid out.
njangi.p3: But a pot that goes round without ever serving anything dies. So does possession without purpose. Keep the ball moving, yes, as long as it knows where it is going.

drills.title: Drills with diagrams
drills.body: Rondos, positional games, small and large-sided games, transitions, finishing. Filter by intention, age and day of the week.

builder.title: The session builder
builder.body: Put a session together in a few taps, or let {{app}} suggest one for the day and the age group.

week.title: The periodised week

match.title: Matches and lineups

live.title: Live analysis

video.title: Video analysis

codes.title: The method's codes
codes.body: Progressive pass, line broken, box entry, regain within 5 seconds: the same codes as the book.

model.title: A shared game model
model.body: The same words and the same drills from U9 to the first team, even when the coach changes.

teams.title: All your teams

education.title: Coach education

mola.title: Mola does the work. You stay in charge.
mola.p1: “Mola” means “mate” in Cameroonian camfranglais. It welcomes you by talking and fills in your profile as you chat. Then it acts in the app with the same tools you use.
mola.p2: Nothing goes out without your say-so: every message waits for your approval.
